title: Curlew
blurb: The curlews are a group of eight species of birds in the genus Numenius, characterised by their long, slender, downcurved bills and mottled brown plumage.
facts: It was first recorded in 1377 in Langland's Piers Plowman "Fissch to lyue in þe flode..Þe corlue by kynde of þe eyre".
In Europe, "curlew" usually refers to one species, the Eurasian curlew.
